summary: ext2_reserve_hosttest.c, the ext2 driver's checks of free and reserved blocks before a write, with faults in rach2/sys/fs/ext2.c

argv:
set -e
t=${WORK}/tree
rm -rf "$t"
mkdir -p "$t/rach2"
cp -R rach2/sys "$t/rach2/sys"
cp -R ${SRC}/. "$t/"
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I "$t/rach2/sys" -I "$t/rach2/sys/lib" -I "$t/rach2/sys/proc" tests/host/ext2_reserve_hosttest.c "$t/rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c" "$t/rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c" -o ${WORK}/ext2_reserve_hosttest

faults.name: estimate
faults.summary: a walk of the data blocks with an estimate of the pointer blocks in place of writeback_space

lines: ext2-reserve-hosttest: fail: boundary shortage is refused before accepting bytes

faults.name: pending
faults.summary: a reservation check that leaves out the blocks the batch has reserved

lines: ext2-reserve-hosttest: fail: piece quota includes uncommitted reservations

faults.name: original
faults.summary: the estimate, with no check in writeback_reserve at all

lines: ext2-reserve-hosttest: fail: unprivileged boundary write preserves reserved blocks
